desc: Derive and verify the prefix-displacement formulation for smoke positions and generation times.
Specify the exact per-character update order: move, query smoke existence, then record the new prefix position.
Choose a robust coordinate representation for Python hash-set membership, such as `(row, col)` tuples.
Implement stdin parsing, direction-to-delta mapping, and accumulation of answer bits.
Check edge cases including positions never reached, repeated prefix positions, and negative coordinates.
